title: Reconstruct an incident as an executable test
question: What must be saved to replay the same situation?
summary: A filter or cluster is a lead for review. Curation creates the complete replayable case and preserves its provenance.

steps.title: Select an accepted review
steps.body: Require the reviewer, expected behavior, and a supporting event from that same conversation.

steps.title: Preserve the original inputs
steps.body: Save the request, original booking, policy, and expected behavior. The final booking is not the replay’s starting state.
steps.excerpt_label: Abbreviated code; full function in notebook.

steps.title: Use independent checks
steps.body: Check untouched flights and approved writes. Assess explanation accuracy separately and retain unavailable judgments.
